blurb: Makana Charters offers 4.5 to 5 hour Na Pali Coast boat tours from Kikiaola Small Boat Harbor in Kekaha or Port Allen. Guests explore sea caves, snorkel in protected coves, see spinner dolphins, and enjoy a deli lunch with drinks onboard. The tours include cultural narration by Native Hawaiian captains about the history and significance of the Na Pali Coast.
extraNote: Kikiaola Small Boat Harbor in Kekaha or Port Allen (Amelia K boat)
